# ship-project

Your interface to the `project` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`project.active_project`](references/docs/project.active_project.mdoc) — The active project and its workspace state.
- [`project.list_projects`](references/docs/project.list_projects.mdoc) — List the registered projects (each a .ship/ directory).

## Commands

- [`project.activate`](references/docs/project.activate.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Switch the daemon's active project.
- [`project.add`](references/docs/project.add.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — Register a directory as a project (ensures its .ship/ exists).
